// diagnostic

E0732

The tag `{tag}` declares a method `{method}`, but tags have no methods.

What

The tag `{tag}` declares a method `{method}`, but tags have no methods.

Why

A `tag` is a marker that erases at runtime; only a `trait` carries methods and dispatches.

Fix

Make `{tag}` a `trait` if `{method}` should dispatch, or remove the method to keep `{tag}` a marker tag.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0732: tests/ui/tag_with_method.stderr.
